content: Isaye sahabi okkolore munazat gora šikar

Ek šome Isaye hono ek zagat duwa gorer. Duwa gora šeš oi bade Isar sahabi okkolor butottu ekzone Isare hodde: "Malik, Yahyaye zendilla hibar šagirit okkolore duwa gora šikaiye hendilla õne ãrare o duwa gora šikao."
Isaye hitarare hodde:

content.text: "Tũwara duwa goribar šomot endilla ho:
"'Ya, ãrar behosti Baf,
Tũwar nam fobitro boli mana ok.
Tũwar raijjo aiyok.
Fotti dinor haiddo tũi fotti din ãrare do.
Ãrar har gunare maf gori do,
zendilla ãra o maf gori hitarare,
zara ãrar berudde hosuri gore.
ar ãrare forikkat foitto no diyo.'"

content: Tarfore Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Mone goro! Tũwarar butore hono ekzonottu ekzon bondu ase. Ar hite zodi ada raitta hitar bondur hãse zai ho, 'Bondu, ãre tinnwa ruṭi udar do,
kiyollahoile ãr ek bondu musafer oi ãr heṛe aišše, hitar munttu ani dibolla ãttu kissu nai.'
Henoile ki he manušwaye butottu tai en zuwab dibo ne, 'Ãre hošto no diyo, ehon doroza banda, ar ãr fuwain ãr ḍake gum giye. Ãi uṛi tũware kissu di no farir.'
Ãi tũwarare hoir, hite zodi bondu hisabe uṛi no de, tarfore o hite bar bar foriyad goredde hiyanolla buli oile o hite uṛibo edde hitar zorulot mozin hitare hin dibo.
"Etolla ãi tũwarare hoir: Munazatot so, toi tũwarare diya oibo. Tuwo, toi tũwara tuwai faiba. Dorozat ṭulki maro, toi tũwaralla kula oibo.
Zara mage hitara to fottizonore diya o, ze tuwa, hite tuwai fa, ar ze dorozat ṭulki de, hitalla doroza kula o.
"Tũwarar butore endilla baf hone ase, fuwaye mas magile haf de,
otóba ãnḍa magile bissu de?
Tũwara zodi horaf oi bade o tũwarar fuwain okkolore uttom uttom ziniš di zano, toile ei hota hoto haṭi ze, zara mage hitarare behostiyo Bafe Pak Ruhure dibo!"

content: Bod ruh okkolor uwore Isar kemota
Ar ek bar Isaye ek buk but dafaiye. But zehon bair oigiyegoi, he buk manušwaye hota howa šuru goijje. Henot manuš okkol tajjuf oiye.
Kintu hitarar butore kiye kiye hodde, "Butor raza Belsebulor modote ite but bair gore."
Ar kiye kiye forikka gori saibolla Isare behostottu ekkan sinno dehaito hoiye.
Kintu Isaye hitarar monor baf buzi faijje edde hibaye hitarare hodde:

content.text: "Ze raijjo bag o hiyan dongšo o, ar gór zodi góror bifokke o hiyan dongšo o.
Hendilla, Šoitane o zodi hitar nizor berudde ai tiya, toile ken gori hitar raijjo ṭikibo? Ar tũwara hor ãi Belsebulor modote but sarai.
Ašša! Ãi zodi Belsebulor modote but sarai, toile tũwarar nizor manuš okkole har modote but sara? Tũwara soiyi hor ne hiyan hitara bisar gori sok.
Kintu ãi zodi Allar kemota loi but sarai, henoile Allar raijjo tũwarar hãse aišše.
"Ekzon bolwala mainše zodi hár ḍoilla ostro loi nizor gór fahara de, toile hitar mal fottoro nirafodot take.
Kintu hitattuwaro bolwala honokiye zodi ai hitar loi zite, toile hite ze ostro okkolor uwore nirbor goijje hin oi manušwaye hari loi felaibo, ar luṛor mallun loi zai bag goribogoi.
"Ãi hoir: Zodi honokiye ãr fokke no take toile hitede ãr bifokke roiye, ze ãr fũwati no feṛa hitede šiṛe."

"Hono napak ruh zehon ekzon manušor butottu bair oi zagoi, hetunot hite aramor zaga tuwaibolla šuwana zagat zai gura fira gore. Bade zodi hite hendilla no fa, hite hode, 'Ãi ze górottu niyoli aiššyi he górot ãi abar firi zaiyumboi.'
Firi ai sadde, górgan foriškar edde hãzaiya.
Hetunot hite zai hitattuwaro aro hãt zon horaf napak ruhure fũwati loi ane edde heṛe goli bošobaš gore. Hiyanolla boli he manušwar doša foila barottuwaro šešor doša aro horaf o."

content: Isaye ei šob hota hodde šomot mainšor zamottu hono ek maya fuwaye guzori Isare hodde, "Mubarok he feṭ, ze õnore feṛot loiye edde bukor dud habaiye."
Kintu Isaye hodde:

content.text: "Iyanottuwaro hitarare mubarak zara Allar kalam fune edde hindilla gore."

content: Ei halor naforman manuš
Toi aro manuš okkole Isare sairo ḍakottu berai doijje, hetunot Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Ei halor manuš okkol horaf, hitara sinno tuwa, kintu Yunus nobir sinno bade ar hono sinno hitarare deha no oibo.
Nineveh šohoror manuš okkololla zendilla Yunus nobi nize sinno oil, ṭik hendilla ei halor manuš okkololla o Adomor Fut sinno oibo.

Bisaror din doin dešor raniye ei halor manuš okkolor fũwati uṛi itarare duši goribo, kiyollahoile hibaye badša Soloimanor giyanor hota funibolla duniyair šeš ḍakottu aiššil. Ar so, eṛe Soloimanottuwaro aro mohan ekzon ase.

Bisaror din Nineveh šohoror manuš okkole ei halor manuš okkolor fũwati uṛi itarare duši goribo, kiyollahoile Yunus nobir toboligor duwara Nineveh šohoror manuš okkole gunattu mon firail. Ar so, eṛe Yunusottuwaro aro mohan ekzon ase.

content: suk oilde gar serag

content.text: "Serag zalai honokiye ũjja góror tole ba laiyor nise no rake, bolke hiyan seragor tokor uwore rake, zene zara butore za hitara fohor deke.
Suk oilde gar serag, tũwar suk zodi taza o, hin hendilla oiyede haron oilde, gagan fohore furaiyade hetolla. Kintu suk zodi taza no o, hin hendilla oiyede haron oilde, gaganot andar ase.
Hetolla so, tũwar butore ze fohor ase hiyan hono andarot ne.
Tũwar šara ga zodi fohore furaiya o, edde ekkagori o andar no take, ṭik serag zendilla nizor teze tũware fohor de, hendilla tũwar hara ga furafuri bafe fohore furaiya oibo."

content: Isaye dórmiyo neta okkolor berudde hor
Isa hota howa šeš gori bade ekzon forošiye Isare hánar dawat diye. Hibaye butore zai hána haito boišše.
Isaye hána háibar age hat no duwede deki forošiwaye ammuwak oiye.
Kintu Malik Isaye hitare hodde:

content.text: "Tũwara Foroši okkole fanir fiyala edde deššir bar ḍakottu foriškar goro kintu tũwarar butore lalos edde naformaniye boraiya.
Murokko manuš okkol! Ze baror ḍak banaiye, hibaye ki butoror ḍak o no bana ne?
Bolke deššir butore za za ase hin gorib okkolore dan goro, toi dekiba, beggun tũwaralla foriškar oibo.

"Bifod tũwara Foroši okkolore, kiyollahoile tũwara Allare fudina, tez fata edde hár ḍoilla hakor doš bagor ek bag di tako. Kintu niyai bisar edde Allar muhabbotor mikka diyan no do. Foilagan falon goribar fũware fũware dusoragan falon gora o tũwarar dorhari.
"Bifod tũwara Foroši okkolore, muzolišhanar mum mikkar zagat boite edde rasta gaṛot ijjot fare muhabbot goro.
"Bifod tũwara Foroši okkolore, tũwara en hobor okkolor ḍoilla zinor hono sinno no take, edde no zani mainše heṛe uwottu ãṛe, ar hitara napak o."

content: Hetunot dórmo šikoya alem okkolor butottu ekzone Isare hodde, "Huzur, õne ei hota hoi ãrare o ofoman goror."
Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Bifod tũwara dórmo šikoya alem okkolore! Tũwara manušor uwore bor fũza tuli do, kintu hitara hin mani farefan modot gori hoi uggwa õl o no laro.
"Bifod tũwarare, tũwara nobi okkolor hoborore mazar banao, otoso tũwarar baf dada okkole hitarare kun goijje.
Iyan deki buza zar ze tũwara tũwarar baf dadar hamot ekmot oiyo, kiyollahoile hitara mari felaiye ar tũwara hitarar hoborore mazar banayo.
Etolla giyani Allaye Allar kalamot hodde, 'Ãi hitarar hãse nobi okkol edde asab okkolore defeṛaiyum. Hitarar butottu ho ekzonore hitara kun goribo edde ar kissur uwore ottisar goribo.'
Hetolla duniyair foilar šuru oite šuru gori zetozon nobire kun gora oiye, hitarar louwor dai oibo ei halor manuš okkol.
Habilor kun oiyede oite šuru gori Zakariya, zare pak zaga edde dórmogóror maza mazi zagat kun gora oiye. Oi, ãi tũwarare hoir, ei halor manuš okkol ei louwor dai oibo.
"Bifod tũwara dórmo šikoya alem okkololla! Tũwara giyanor sabi nizor hãse raki diyo. Giyanor butore tũwara o no golila, ar zara butore goilto saiye hitarare o tiya garai felaiyo."

content: Toi Isaye hentu niyoli zargoide šomot dórmiyo alem okkol edde Foroši okkole mezaz gorom gori bout ḍoilla suwal okkol loi Isar uwore zafai foijje.
Hitara Isare mukor hotat bul doribolla fand buwai raikke.
